themes.name: High Contrast
themes.author: Grimoire
themes.description: Maximum legibility: pure black surfaces, white body text, and bright accents. Every foreground clears WCAG AAA (7:1) against every background, and the low-contrast greys of the default theme are removed. Raises luminance contrast only — it does not address colourblindness, which needs more than a change of colour.

themes.name: High Contrast Light
themes.author: Grimoire
themes.description: Maximum legibility on a light background: pure white surfaces, black body text, and deeply saturated accents. Every foreground clears WCAG AAA (7:1) against every background. Raises luminance contrast only — it does not address colourblindness, which needs more than a change of colour.
